title: Ride with GPS Route Elevation Gain Leaderboard
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ridewithgps:route elevation_gain_m=*
| stats sum(elevation_gain_m) as total_value, avg(elevation_gain_m) as avg_value by surface_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks surface values by total and average elevation gain across Ride with GPS route events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `elevation_gain_m` values for each Ride with GPS route event and review total and average elevation gain by surface.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total elevation gain.
grandmaExplanation: It will spot which surface shows the biggest elevation gain numbers in your Ride with GPS route data.
